title: Illustration metadata
description: Metadata for one illustration. Lives in `meta.json` next to the illustration's `.svg` file.

title.description: Human readable name shown in the documentation.

description.description: Short description of what the illustration shows and when to use it.

tags.description: Searchable tags used for filtering, e.g. "person", "teknologi".

project.description: Projects the illustration was made for, e.g. ["eIDAS"]. Project illustrations are hidden in the documentation until one of their projects is picked. Leave out for the profile's standard illustrations.
